title: Repeatable AND-combined label filters across query commands
description:
The query family accepts the label filter only once (`--label a --label b` fails with "cannot be used multiple times") while issue search AND-combines repeated labels. Orchestrators cannot express "ready work in epic X with component Y" through the commands built for that purpose; the failure was confirmed live.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: query all/available/blocked and the issue list command accept a repeated label flag, AND-combined, matching issue search semantics.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: Help text states the AND semantics on every command taking the label filter.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Single-label invocations behave exactly as before.
